title: Schooner Hindu and the Cutter Bloodhound

services.name: Sailing Trips
services.desc: Discover the timeless beauty of the Schooner Hindu, a 1925 gaff-rigged schooner steeped in history and charm. This classic vessel has been lovingly restored to offer elegant and historically rich sailing experiences. Our sunset sails find a balance between being tranquil and rowdy. In light of this we do not have a youth price for our sunset sails, and discourage those with small children from riding with us for our evening sail. Sail Through History on our 1925 Gaff-Rigged Schooner and experience Key West’s most breathtaking sunset on the water.
